description: Main FastAPI application for the investment teaser generator backend, including route definitions for scraping, uploading files, company confirmation, teaser generation and updates, and PDF export.

classes.name: ScrapeRequest
classes.description: Request model containing URL for scraping company info

classes.name: ScrapeResponse
classes.description: Response model containing scraped company info and status

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Response model for uploaded files info

classes.name: CompanyInfo
classes.description: Structured information about a company used in responses

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyRequest
classes.description: Request model for confirming company data

classes.name: ConfirmCompanyResponse
classes.description: Response containing the session ID after confirmation

classes.name: TeaserGenerationRequest
classes.description: Request model for generating teaser including session ID and selected files

classes.name: TeaserGenerationResponse
classes.description: Response with teaser content, status, and metadata

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Basic endpoint to check API health

methods.name: scrape_company(req: ScrapeRequest)
methods.description: Scrapes company info from a website URL

methods.name: upload_files( files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more files to upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX)."), company_id: Optional[UUID] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles file uploads and saves them to DB

methods.name: confirm_company( req: ConfirmCompanyRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Confirms or edits company info and creates a session

methods.name: generate_teaser( req: TeaserGenerationRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Generates teaser content using AI models

methods.name: update_teaser( teaser_id: UUID, updated: TeaserContent = Body(..., description="Updated teaser content and title"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
export_teaser( teaser_id: UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Exports teaser as a downloadable PDF file

ctags.name: update_teaser
ctags.signature: ( teaser_id: UUID, updated: TeaserContent = Body(..., description="Updated teaser content and title"), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: upload_files
ctags.signature: ( files: List[UploadFile] = File(..., description="One or more files to upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX)."), company_id: Optional[UUID] = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
